config_name: XPS 16 — Core Ultra 7 358H (Arc), 32GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 16" FHD+ 120Hz non-touch

specs.ports: 3x Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) with DP 2.1 + PD, universal audio jack
specs.keyboard_notes: Backlit keyboard, zero-lattice design, Gorilla Glass 3 palmrest

battery.notes: 70Wh. Up to 31h claimed on 2K LCD @250 nits; H-series chip trims ~0.5h vs base in mixed use.

price.notes: VERIFIED dell.ca 2026-11-24: CAD $3,599.99 featured 'Black Friday' config (est. value $4,599.99, $1,000 off). Cheapest full-spec XPS 16.

reviews.quote: the XPS 16 is a fantastic laptop befitting of the premium XPS name

praises: Best-value XPS 16: $1,000 off puts 16-core + 32GB + 1TB in a 1.74 kg chassis under $3,600
Smooth video editing and multitasking per dell.ca owner reviews on this spec class
1-120Hz 500-nit LCD delivers the line's best battery (up to 31h claimed)
Owners repeatedly call it 'premium build' with fast setup and long battery life
Arc iGPU tier handles light gaming far better than the 8-core entry
complaints: FHD+ 1200p on 16" is the weakest screen in the line — pixel density noticeably soft
No discrete GPU option at all on the 2026 XPS 16 (CNET: 'RTX-level price without RTX GPU' applies to OLED tiers)
USB-C-only; no HDMI or SD despite the creator marketing
Occasional early-life defects reported: loose screens, battery errors (dell.ca review summary)

design_philosophy: The volume XPS 16 config and Dell's Black Friday hero SKU: full 16-core Panther Lake with Arc iGPU and 32GB, paired with the most efficient panel to hit the headline 31-hour claim. It embodies the 2026 XPS shift from dGPU muscle to thin-and-endurance.
rating_notes: Inferred from CNET XPS 16 (2026) 8.0 anchor: 358H + Arc + 32GB matches the reviewed performance class → productivity 8.5, gaming 4.5 (Arc ~4.5 per NOTES). FHD+ panel keeps screen_quality 6.5 and battery 9.0.
